transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I constantly feel like I'm being watched and monitored, and I've also been hearing voices that other people can't hear. This has been going on for about two years and three months now, so I finally decided to seek some help.
Have you had any periods during these two years when you felt unusually high or energized, needed much less sleep, or felt very depressed for weeks at a time?
No, I haven't ever felt unusually high or full of energy like that, and my sleep is usually okay. I also haven't had any long periods where I felt really depressed.
Have these experiences affected your work, school, relationships, or daily functioning, or have you noticed any other symptoms like disorganized speech or behavior?

I have noticed that my thoughts get a bit tangled and I'll jump quickly between unrelated topics or get off-track when I'm talking. As for how all of this affects my work or relationships, I'm not really sure and haven't thought much about it.
Do you have any other fixed beliefs besides being watched or monitored, or is that the main thing you’ve been experiencing?

Being watched and monitored is definitely the main and most distressing thing I experience constantly. However, I also frequently feel like random events, news broadcasts, or things people say around me are specifically directed at me and have a special meaning. But the feeling of being monitored is definitely the most constant part of it.
Have these symptoms made it hard for you to keep up with work, school, or relationships, or to take care of yourself day to day?
Things have been pretty difficult and confusing for me lately. I'm just not entirely sure how to describe the impact it's having on my daily life and work right now.
Besides the voices, have you ever seen things that other people could not see, or had other unusual sensory experiences?

Yes, I have seen figures and shapes that other people couldn't see. I also sometimes feel strange crawling sensations on my skin, smell odd odors like smoke, and taste unusual metallic flavors when there's nothing in my mouth.
Have you been able to work, study, or take care of yourself about as usual, or have these symptoms clearly interfered with your daily life?
I'm really not sure how much it has affected my work or daily life. It is just hard for me to say how much things have changed compared to before.
Before these symptoms started, were you functioning normally at work, school, and socially, and have you noticed a clear decline since then?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't thought much about how I was doing before all of this started compared to now.
Have these symptoms made it hard for you to keep up with work, school, or relationships, or to take care of yourself day to day?
I'm really not sure if it has made things harder for me. I haven't really thought about how it affects my daily routine, work, or relationships.
